gloss: local area, actual site, on location

definitions.gloss: local area, actual site, on location
definitions.explanation: The place where something actually happens or exists, as opposed to a remote or central location. Emphasizes being physically present at the relevant location, whether domestically or abroad.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}の{情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: To gather information on the ground.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}{時間|じかん}の{午前|ごぜん}10{時|じ}に{到着|とうちゃく}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We are scheduled to arrive at 10 a.m. local time.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}が{現地|げんち}に{入|はい}り、{被災|ひさい}{状況|じょうきょう}を{詳|くわ}しくリポートした。
examples.english: Reporters entered the area and gave a detailed report on the disaster situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {現地|げんち}の (local), {現地|げんち}で (on-site, locally). When referring to foreign locations, it emphasizes the perspective of being at that actual place rather than back home. Common in news, business, and travel contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現地|げんち}{時間|じかん}: local time
- {現地|げんち}{調査|ちょうさ}: on-site investigation
- {現地|げんち}スタッフ: local staff
- {現地|げんち}の{人|ひと}: local people
- {現地|げんち}{集合|しゅうごう}: meeting at the site
